probes.question: How many people are needed for a better-than-even chance that two share a birthday?

image.alt: iss073e0134965 (June 7, 2025) --- NASA astronaut and Expedition 73 Flight Engineer Anne McClain celebrates her 46th birthday with a cake, gifts, and cards aboard the International Space Station's Unit

body.question: How many people do you need in a room for a better-than-even chance that two share a birthday?
body.reveal: Only 23. With 23 people there are 253 pairs to compare, which gives about a 51% chance of a match. With 70 people it is above 99.9%.
